KHOORV ZRZGXHUU

(Note: The instruction requires every letter to be shifted three places forward. "KHOORV ZRZGXHUU" decodes to "Holton Supply".)

Holton Supply quotes 140 per unit (meets "at most 140"), delivers in 5 days (meets "within 6 days"), and holds a rating of 9 out of 10 (meets "at least 6").

Other candidates:
- Orlford Outfitters: 15/unit, 10 days (fails delivery).
- Orlhurst Works: 95/unit, 14 days (fails delivery).
- Lunnick Outfitters: 35/unit, 9 days (fails delivery).
- Kelby Traders: 105/unit, 2 days, rating 4 (fails rating).
- Zelton Works: 70/unit, 8 days (fails delivery).
- Calton Traders: 15/unit, 15 days (fails delivery).
- Hardale Traders: 165/unit (fails price).

Only Holton Supply meets all criteria.

KHOORV ZRZGXHUU
